summary.description: What this step did, in a few sentences.

done.description: Your item's definition of done, statement by statement: each statement as the item gives it, whether it holds now, and what shows it - the test that pins it, or what you ran. Every statement of the item's is here.

statement.description: One statement of the item's definition of done, as the item gives it.

holds.description: True only where what `shows` names was run or read in this step and showed it.

shows.description: What shows it: the test that pins it and what it showed, or what you ran; where it does not hold, why.

built.description: What you built or changed, by file.

tested.description: Each command you ran in this step, word for word, with its exit code and what showed the result; and what you could not run, and why.

claims.description: What you claim of your own work. The engine builds and tests it itself, so say what you saw, not what you expect.

closure.description: The record of each class of this item's work, one entry per class - those the item's classes name and any the builder found that the plan lacked, under a new id of its own (N1, N2, ...). Empty only where the item declares no class and found none. Nothing is folded without the record.

class.description: The class's id, as the item's classes name it - or the new id (N1, N2, ...) of a class the builder found that the plan lacked.

invariant.description: The invariant the class holds, as the item planned it or as the work now holds it.

path.description: The one home's path, from the repository's root.

symbol.description: The declaration that is the home.

home.description: The one home that decides, as the item planned it or as the work moved it.

why.description: Why the home moved, where the work moved it.

homeMoved.description: Given only where the work moved the home.

sites.description: Every site of the class, before and after the work: a site the plan missed that the search found is added here. One entry per site, the home among them.

path.description: The site's path, from the repository's root.

symbol.description: The declaration at the site; empty where the site is a whole file, a configuration entry or a literal.

before.description: What the site was before the work: how it decided the class's question then.

after.description: What the work left the site: the home (one entry only), a reader of the home, deleted, or the only site there was.

searches.description: Each search that looked for sites of the class, by the data that decides - the kind, the key, the diagnostic, the literal.

data.description: The data the search searched: the kind, the key, the diagnostic or the literal.

via.description: What ran the search: the graph tool, a command, a reading of files.

query.description: What the search asked, word for word.

call.description: The id of the tool call in this item's stored streams that made the search; empty where the search was made without one.

axes.description: Each axis of the universe the class names, with the values the work covered.

values.description: The values of the axis the work covered, each direction and form among them.

cellsPinned.description: How many cells of the universe the pin covers.

cellsArmed.description: How many cells of the universe the arm covers, where the repository keeps mutation arms; else 0.

tests.description: The tests that pin the invariant, by name.

tableDriven.description: True only where the tests are table-driven over the universe the class names - not over the reported case.

over.description: The table the tests are driven by: the vocabulary's source, named as the code holds it.

arm.description: The mutation arm of the class, where the repository keeps mutation arms: the arm's id and its site - the home. Where it keeps none, or the class has no arm, an object holding why. Where it keeps them and the class has one, an empty arm is refused by the fold's check.

id.description: The arm's id, as the registry names it.

site.description: The site the arm mutates - the home.

why.description: Why the class has no arm: the repository keeps none, or the class has nothing to mutate.

neighbours.description: Each neighbour swept before reporting: the same invariant at the other cells, the opposite direction, and the optimised form of the same source - measured with the measure tool on each leg and each reference separately, or named unmeasured with the reason.

cell.description: The cell of the universe measured.

direction.description: The direction measured: the same, or the opposite.

form.description: The form measured: the same source, or its optimised form as closure.md names it.

reference.description: What it was measured on: the leg, or the reference.

measuredBy.description: The id of the measure call that measured it; empty where it is unmeasured.

result.description: What the measurement showed: passed, failed and fixed in this item, or unmeasured.

reason.description: Where it is unmeasured, why; empty where it measured.

claim.description: The closing claim, which names the universe and never the case: 'Invariant I holds over U; cells C measured on references R; cells N not measured because B'.

homeAudit.description: The home audit, where the home was touched by other work of this run or the class was reopened twice: what the audit consolidated, the invariants the home should uphold, and what is now structural - one decision, one place.

consolidated.description: What was consolidated: each decision the home took over from its sites.

invariants.description: The invariants the home should uphold, and those it upheld only by coincidence.

structural.description: What is now structural: one decision, one place, with where it lives.

arms.description: The mutation arms this item's work declares, by id, as the registry will name them - the flat list of every class's arm, read by the item's own sweep after its checkpoint. Empty where the repository keeps no mutation arms or the work declares none.

reuse.description: Existing code you built on that the item did not name, and anything you created that the item did not list as new, with why. Empty where you held to the item's lists.

newRows.description: The id of every registry row filed in this work that the registry did not have before it, said again in full in each report; empty where none was filed or the repository keeps no registry.

blocked.description: What the item asks for that only a person can give - a decision, an access, a change outside your paths that only someone else may make - each with what stands in the way and what would let it be done. Empty where you can do all of it, and always empty while you work through a review's findings, where what you cannot do is a declined finding. Where it is not empty, a person is asked, with a recommendation, before anything of the item is tested or folded.

what.description: What of the item you cannot do.

why.description: What stands in the way, as you found it: a path outside the ones you may write, an access you lack, or a decision nobody made.

needs.description: What would let it be done: a decision, an access, a change elsewhere, and from whom.

declined.description: Each review finding you did not act on because you hold it wrong, with why; said again in full in each report, those of earlier rounds among them, until you act on it. Empty where you declined none.

finding.description: The finding as the review gave it: its aspect, its place and what it said.

why.description: Why it is wrong, in terms a reviewer can check in the code.

preExisting.description: Issues you met that were there before this run - outside what it changed - each reported and never fixed by you. Empty where you met none.

title.description: One line: what is wrong, and where.

description.description: What is wrong and what it causes, as you saw it.

where.description: The paths, from the repository's root, or the command.

evidence.description: What you read or ran and saw, quoted: the file and its lines, or the command and what it printed.

blocks.description: True only where it stops your own work.
